players.product: Ultrapure water supply systems for semiconductor fabs (wafer and chip cleaning), wastewater treatment and recycling systems, ultrapure ion exchange resins and water treatment chemicals for electronics

quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): net sales JPY 177,654 million (+8.8% YoY; +1.5% vs the initial plan of JPY 175,000 million) and operating profit JPY 37,648 million (+21.0%; initial plan JPY 31,500 million), operating margin 21.2% (19.1% a year earlier); sales and every profit level beat the prior year and the initial plan and were record highs. Orders received JPY 167,956 million (+11.0%) were 6.7% below the initial plan of JPY 180,000 million. ROE 21.5%. Management states capex for mass production of advanced semiconductors stayed at a high level all year on the rapid growth of generative-AI demand and full-scale data-center investment, while demand for power semiconductors for automotive and similar uses stayed weak as EV market growth slowed; general industry and social infrastructure (power, water and sewage) were firm, centred on maintenance demand.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 177,654 million (+8.8%); operating profit JPY 37,648 million (+21.0%); operating margin 21.2%

quarterly_data.signal: Order backlog (annual securities report): the order backlog carried into the next year was JPY 96,503 million at March 31, 2026 (-8.8% YoY; initial plan JPY 110,778 million) - Water Treatment Engineering JPY 94,212 million (-9.5%), Performance Products JPY 2,291 million (+34.9%). Management states orders missed the initial plan because the timing of some large electronics orders slipped into the next fiscal year, although large semiconductor projects were won in Taiwan, the US and Europe; the company plans to win several large semiconductor projects from fiscal 2026 (the year to March 2027) onward.
quarterly_data.figure: Order backlog JPY 96,503 million (-8.8%); Water Treatment Engineering backlog JPY 94,212 million (-9.5%)

quarterly_data.signal: Segments, year to March 2026 (annual securities report): Water Treatment Engineering orders JPY 141,685 million (+12.2%), sales JPY 151,961 million (+10.0%), operating profit JPY 34,339 million (+25.4%) - electronics plant projects in Japan, Taiwan and the US progressed well and the solutions business (equipment-ownership services and maintenance) was strong; profit rose on the higher-margin solutions mix, smooth progress of profitable plant projects and gross-margin gains from profit improvement and cost reduction, mainly on overseas plant projects, absorbing higher SG&A (personnel and IT costs); social infrastructure orders rose on new and expanded thermal power plant projects. Performance Products orders JPY 26,270 million (+5.3%), sales JPY 25,693 million (+2.2%), operating profit JPY 3,309 million (-11.5%) - compact pure-water units for medical and research institutions, functional materials for high-level separation and purification of electronic materials used in semiconductor manufacturing, and RO membrane treatment and wastewater treatment chemicals for the electronics industry grew, while low-margin food transactions were trimmed and higher SG&A (mainly personnel) cut profit. Production (at selling prices): Water Treatment Engineering JPY 169,765 million (+17.1%), Performance Products JPY 12,285 million (-0.5%), total JPY 182,051 million (+15.7%).
quarterly_data.figure: Water Treatment Engineering sales JPY 151,961 million (+10.0%), operating profit JPY 34,339 million (+25.4%); Performance Products sales JPY 25,693 million (+2.2%)

quarterly_data.signal: Concentration and sales by region (annual securities report): Water Treatment Engineering is 85.5% of consolidated sales, and the electronics industry (semiconductors, electronic components and the like) accounts for more than half of it (71.1% in the year to March 2026); 56.7% of trade receivables at March 31, 2026 were owed by the top three customers, and management expects concentration on its main markets and customers to rise further. Sales by customer location, year to March 2026: Japan JPY 111,128 million, Taiwan JPY 44,220 million, US JPY 9,710 million (shown separately for the first time as it became material; JPY 2,324 million a year earlier), China JPY 6,185 million, Southeast Asia JPY 5,601 million, other JPY 808 million. Lease investment assets from equipment-ownership services (water treatment facilities Organo installs and owns on customer sites) were JPY 53,856 million at year-end, growing with the scale of electronics-industry facilities.
quarterly_data.figure: Taiwan sales JPY 44,220 million; US sales JPY 9,710 million; top three customers 56.7% of trade receivables

quarterly_data.signal: Medium- to long-term plan 'ORGANO 2030' revised (annual securities report): with the plan for fiscal 2026 (the year to March 2027) as the starting point, the targets for fiscal 2030 (the year to March 2031) are now net sales of JPY 2,600 hundred million (7% average annual growth) and an operating margin of 18% or more; the plan also aims to keep ROE at 20% or more. Management states demand for advanced semiconductors for generative AI and data centers is expanding rapidly, supply is expected to stay short of demand for the time being, and it expects capex for advanced semiconductors in Taiwan (where the company has a high share) and the US (where it is expanding) to be more active than ever; it will expand delivery capacity by strengthening its global engineering organisation, and expects the semiconductor share of its business and its concentration on specific major customers and regions (Taiwan, US) to rise further. Priorities: growing the stable-revenue solutions business first; the US market as the top regional priority (electronics as the pillar, plus chemicals, separation and purification, compact units, water systems for pharmaceuticals and new sewage treatment technology); a local subsidiary in India (Organo India, set up February 19, 2026 for market research). Management also expects to apply its separation and purification technology to high-purity refining of chemicals and solvents used in semiconductor manufacturing.
quarterly_data.figure: Fiscal 2030 (year to March 2031) target: net sales JPY 2,600 hundred million (7% average annual growth); operating margin 18% or more

quarterly_data.signal: R&D, year to March 2026 (annual securities report): R&D expenses JPY 3,371 million - Water Treatment Engineering JPY 2,625 million, Performance Products JPY 745 million. Water Treatment Engineering R&D centres on core separation-purification and high-level analysis technology for the ultrapure water and chemicals quality that electronic-device manufacturing needs; in the year the company developed in-house 'ORTOC', an online monitor of trace organics to raise the reliability of next-generation ultrapure water quality, advanced AI-based operating control of water treatment facilities, and worked on PFAS analysis and treatment. Performance Products developed a new tracer-containing chemical for optimised cooling-water management and is developing high-performance chemicals for water treatment membranes and high-performance materials for high-purity chemicals essential to advanced semiconductor processes.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D JPY 3,371 million (Water Treatment Engineering JPY 2,625 million; Performance Products JPY 745 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure (annual securities report): capex including intangibles was JPY 3,520 million in the year to March 2026 - Water Treatment Engineering JPY 2,920 million, mainly a training center for engineers and business software; Performance Products JPY 599 million, mainly R&D assets and food-processing materials equipment. At year-end there were no newly decided plans for significant new facilities or disposals.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 3,520 million (Water Treatment Engineering JPY 2,920 million; Performance Products JPY 599 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Material contract and key-material sourcing (annual securities report): Organo holds the sole agency rights in Japan for sales of ion exchange resins such as 'Amberlite' handled by FilmTec Water Japan (renamed from DDP Specialty Products Japan on October 1, 2025), under a contract running from January 1990 to December 2026 that is renewed every year. The company states it depends on specific suppliers for key materials such as ion exchange resins.
quarterly_data.figure: Contract term January 1990 to December 2026, renewed every year
